# Shield Generators
Shield generators get a few new uses on planets; as well as an entirely new class...
## Shuttles
As a quick refresher; when your shuttle is over the mass capacity that your gravity generators can counteract, you will plummet.
However, all shield generators in the Colossus sector are programmed with an emergency sequence in case of ground collisons of this class. When hitting the ground, your shield generator will atempt to take the impact in the same manner as a bullet; if this succeeds, you will safely land without issue.
In the event that your shield generator is unable to handle the full load, it will still take the impact; however, the overclock required to take the sudden hit will [italic][color=red]entirely disable your shields.[/color][/italic] If this happens, priority should be restoring ship power to your gravity generators and allowing your shields time to fully respool.
